title: What I Carry
caption:
What I Carry

For years now, my work has kept me moving.
I live with a suitcase in one hand,
and over time, my things have become fewer.

I have found real happiness in this simple way of living.

Having less does not simply mean owning less.
It means choosing.
Before I buy something, I ask:
Is this really me? Does it suit the way I live?
And when something no longer fits,
I can let it go without hesitation.

Living only with what I truly need —
what I wear, what I keep around me —
feels like me.
It leaves room for what I want to focus on.

That is why I do this work.
Choosing only what each person truly needs,
with nothing extra to buy.
I hope to share the joy of having just enough,
wherever in the world I go.
